planets.name: Moon
planets.source_credit: NASA Scientific Visualization Studio / Ernie Wright; LRO LROC and LOLA teams
limitations: NASA visualization color map optimized for aesthetics, not science; exposure/white balance adjusted and high-latitude gaps inpainted.
LROC color covers 70 N to 70 S; polar regions use lower resolution monochromatic LOLA albedo fill.
JPEG derivatives are display imagery, not scientific feature or similarity evidence.

displacement.reference: LOLA radial elevation relative to 1737.4 km sphere; source Float32 km multiplied by 1000. Pixel-center lon=-179.875+0.25*c, lat=89.875-0.25*r.

planets.name: Mars
planets.source_credit: NASA/Jet Propulsion Laboratory & Caltech; Viking images processed at USGS
limitations: NASA published Viking/USGS/JPL-Caltech visualization texture; not certified natural/true color or calibrated photometry.
Native source is 1440 by 720 pixels; coarse global display only, no metre-scale surface detail.
Display orientation empirically matched to ASU planetocentric -180..180 north-up mosaic; no independent datum transformation or local tie-point registration.
Global 0.25-degree binned MOLA product; about 14.8 km north-south spacing, with finer east-west spacing toward the poles.
Provider interpolation fills cells without direct altimetry returns. Valid grid coverage is not direct measurement coverage.
MOLA IAU2000 elevation and Viking display imagery are approximately co-located; independent tie-point registration is unverified.

displacement.reference: MOLA MEGR90N000CB signed big-endian Int16 DN is radius minus 3396000 m; conversion to little-endian Float32 preserves each integer DN. Columns rolled by 720 from source 0..360 east to -180..180. Pixel centers: lon=-179.875+0.25*c, lat=89.875-0.25*r. IAU2000 planetocentric.
